summary: Grouse Mountain lookout, Kaniksu NF: a 1921 ten-by-ten frame cabin, staffed 1921 and 1933; removed or destroyed on an unknown date. No source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Sources disagree on whether the cabin was removed or destroyed, and none gives a date.

events.note: Newspaper item (quoted by Forest Lookouts) reports a lightning fire reported to the forest office from the lookout; the 1921 cabin date may not describe this structure, and the sources do not say

notes_for_editor: Dates conflict. A 1914 newspaper item (via Forest Lookouts) already places a lookout here, while firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts date a 10x10 frame cabin to 1921; the story does not link the two. The end is unresolved: removed (Forest Lookouts), destroyed (Idaho Fire Lookouts), R.I.P. with unknown end (firelookout.com). The brief's location conflict is unresolved: the record uses the Idaho Fire Lookouts point (48.50793, -116.2555) while the FFLA point is 48.49728, -116.26597; no page read gives coordinates. Staffing facts are left out of facts because the tower is gone; the staffing events carry the dated names. No new photos: the record already has the Idaho Fire Lookouts 1921 image.
